maintenance.title: Optimizing the database
maintenance.body: This can take a few minutes. Your proxies are still running.

databaseMaintenance.title: Database
databaseMaintenance.description: Charon looks after its database by itself, so there is nothing you need to do here. This page just shows how things stand.

automatic.start: Checked at every start: Charon looks at the database each time it starts.
automatic.convert: Converted once when worthwhile: if the file holds a lot of unused space, Charon converts it one time, during a start, so it can give that space back.
automatic.drain: Handed back after each hourly cleanup: after the hourly clean-up of old data, Charon returns the freed space to your disk.

fields.walHint: Extra files next to the database that SQLite folds back in on its own.

mode.none: Not automatic yet: freed space stays inside the file until Charon next optimizes the database (checked at every start)
mode.incremental: Automatic: freed space goes back to your disk on its own
mode.full: Automatic: freed space goes back to your disk immediately

last.title: Last optimization
last.none: No optimization has been needed so far.
last.convertedPending: Optimized{{when}}: {{before}} → {{after}} (saved {{saved}}). The last cleanup step finishes in the background.
last.failed: The last optimization{{when}} did not finish. Charon will try again by itself.
last.interrupted: The last optimization{{when}} was interrupted. Charon will try again by itself.
last.unknown: The database was last looked at{{when}}.

reason.integrity_check_failed: the database did not pass its safety check
reason.caddy_not_ready: the proxy engine was not ready yet
reason.internal_error: an unexpected internal problem came up
reason.insufficient_disk: there was not enough free disk space
reason.disabled_by_env: it is turned off by the server configuration
reason.already_optimized: the database was already set up to return unused space on its own
reason.nothing_to_reclaim: there was no unused space worth reclaiming
reason.below_threshold: too little space could have been reclaimed to be worth it

databaseMaintenance.reclaimOptional: Charon already does this automatically. This only schedules it for the next start.
databaseMaintenance.reclaimHelper: {{size}} could be reclaimed. Charon restarts only when you restart it (for example after an update).
databaseMaintenance.reasonIncremental: Nothing to do: the database already returns unused space automatically.
databaseMaintenance.reasonTooSmall: Not worth reclaiming: only a small part of the file (under about 100 MB) is unused.
databaseMaintenance.scheduled: Scheduled - the space is reclaimed the next time Charon starts.
databaseMaintenance.disabledReason: Disabled by CHARON_DB_COMPACT_ON_START=off on this server.

notice.restartToOptimize: Charon will reclaim about {{size}} automatically the next time it starts; nothing is needed from you.
notice.databaseBusy: Optimization was postponed because the database was in use; it will be retried on the next start.
notice.disabledByEnv: Optimization is turned off by the server configuration (CHARON_DB_COMPACT_ON_START=off). Your earlier request is kept and applies again once that setting is removed.
notice.insufficientDisk: Charon could not run its automatic database cleanup because the disk is nearly full. Free some disk space and Charon will try again by itself. It needs {{required}} free and {{available}} is available.
notice.tooManyFailures: Charon stopped trying its automatic database cleanup after several failed or interrupted attempts. Your proxies are not affected. Check the logs and make sure there is enough free disk space, and let the optimization finish; avoid restarting while it runs. To let Charon try again, use the optional button below to schedule it, then restart Charon.

presets.basic:
Minimale Sicherheits-Header für maximale Kompatibilität.
✓ Ideal für: Tests, Entwicklung, einfache Websites.
✓ Kompatibel mit allen Anwendungen und mobilen Apps.
presets.apiFriendly:
Optimiert für mobile Apps und API-Clients.
✓ Ideal für: Radarr, Sonarr, Plex, Jellyfin, Home Assistant, Vaultwarden.
✓ Starke Transport-Sicherheit, erlaubt Cross-Origin-Zugriff.
Empfohlen für Dienste, auf die über mobile Apps zugegriffen wird.
presets.strict:
Starke Sicherheit für Web-Anwendungen.
✓ Ideal für: Web-only Dashboards, Admin-Panels.
⚠ Kann mobile Apps und API-Clients beeinträchtigen.
Nicht empfohlen für Radarr, Plex oder Dienste mit Companion-Apps.
presets.paranoid:
Maximale Sicherheit für Hochrisiko-Anwendungen.
✓ Ideal für: Banking, Gesundheitswesen, Compliance-kritische Apps.
⚠ WIRD mobile Apps, API-Clients und OAuth-Flows beeinträchtigen.
Nur verwenden, wenn Sie jeden Header verstehen und anpassen können.

externalProxy.portHint: Geben Sie einen Port (1024–65535) zum Aktivieren oder 0 zum Deaktivieren ein.
externalProxy.securityWarning: Dadurch werden Docker-API-Endpunkte in Ihrem lokalen Netzwerk freigegeben. Stellen Sie sicher, dass der Port durch eine Firewall geschützt und nur für vertrauenswürdige Hosts zugänglich ist.
externalProxy.reconnectNotice: Portänderung wird bei der nächsten Agentenverbindung wirksam.

writeMode.title: Write Access — {{name}}
writeMode.description: Opt this agent into full, unrestricted Docker Engine API access through its External Docker Proxy.
writeMode.confirmHint: Enabling write access requires typing the agent's exact current name.
writeMode.securityWarning: Enabling write mode gives any tool connected through this agent's External Docker Proxy full, unrestricted control of the Docker Engine API on this machine — equivalent to direct access to the Docker socket, including creating privileged containers, mounting the host filesystem, and any other Docker operation. There is no allowlist restricting which endpoints or container configurations are permitted. Every request is logged. Only enable this for agents connecting trusted tools.
writeMode.reconnectNotice: Write mode change will take effect on next agent reconnect.
writeMode.restartRequiredToast: "{{name}}" is connected — restart the Orthrus agent on its remote machine for the write-mode change to take effect.
